name: dumbbell reverse grip incline bench one arm row
description: A one-arm row with an underhand grip, supported on an incline bench. It works the upper back and biceps one side at a time.
instructions: Set a bench to about 45 degrees and lie chest down on it, feet on the floor.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand with an underhand grip, palm facing forward, arm hanging straight.
Row the dumbbell toward your hip, keeping your elbow close to your side.
Squeeze your back at the top.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch arms.
